853:t_80:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I wonder what world that 'art of combat beyond skill' they're always talking about is from...」

853:t_81:4.en:
$$葵$$
「While we're at it, all of $$チームＤ$$ will accept that line together.」

853:t_81:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, Miss $$葵$$, Miss $$くらら$$, Mr. $$朔哉$$, Mr. $$ジョニー$$, and Miss $$エイーダ$$!」

853:t_81:8.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Lately it's been nothing but combined sorties, so somehow we've kind of faded into the background...」

853:t_81:9.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「But we're part of $$チームＤ$$ too, after all.」

853:t_81:10.en:
$$エイーダ$$
「We all won this ace pilot title together, didn't we?」

853:t_81:13.en:
$$ジョニー$$
「In that case, I'll put my cooking skills to use for the first time in a while.」

853:t_81:15.en:
$$朔哉$$
「Hoo boy... I'm already stuffed before we've even eaten...」

853:t_81:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Um... aren't you going to invite me to that party...?」

853:t_82:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Mr. $$シモン$$'s drill is in top form as always.」

853:t_82:6.en:
$$シモン$$
「Flattering me like that won't work. I'm not doing any more kanji drills, arithmetic drills, or mandrills.」

853:t_82:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not at all... This is the drill I've prepared for Mr. $$シモン$$ this time.」

853:t_82:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The egg wash brushed onto bread and other baked goods to give the surface a shine is called a 'drilure'.」

853:t_82:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then, Mr. $$シモン$$! How will you conquer this drilure!?」

853:t_82:11.en:
$$シモン$$
「What's there to conquer? It's food, so I just eat it. Here goes.」

853:t_82:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Aah...! My snack, gone in an instant...!」

853:t_82:14.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What on earth was I trying to do...?」

853:t_83:4.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「That's far enough, AG. Come any closer and you'll become a target for my rifle.」

853:t_83:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Um... I'm already so far away I can't even see your face properly...」

853:t_83:10.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「For safety, I need you to back off right to the limit of my rifle's range.」

853:t_83:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No way! Isn't that the same as telling me to get off the ship!?」

853:t_84:4.en:
$$ギミー$$
「Don't I finally have the gravitas of $$大グレン団$$'s Assault Captain?」

853:t_84:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Indeed. All that's left is to master the drill the way Mr. $$シモン$$ did, and you'll be perfect.」

853:t_84:6.en:
$$ギミー$$
「But there's no drill on $$ガンマール$$, you know.」

853:t_84:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I thought you might say that, so I've prepared one right here.」

853:t_84:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This animal is a mandrill. Mr. $$シモン$$ made good use of one too.」

853:t_84:10.en:
$$ギミー$$
「Then I'll do it! I'll catch up to $$シモン$$ and pass him! I won't lose!」

853:t_84:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(If he has that fire, Mr. $$ギミー$$ will grow even further. I'll personally guarantee it.)

853:t_85:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That lovely smile... Miss $$ダリー$$ is stepping up from a girl to a grown woman, isn't she?」

853:t_85:7.en:
$$ダリー$$
「If you come any closer, I'll shoot!」

853:t_85:9.en:
$$ダリー$$
「$$ヨーコ$$ and everyone told me that if AG comes leering up to me, I'm to firmly push AG away.」

853:t_85:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... to think I could feel your growth even in a place like this. I don't know whether to be glad or sad...」

853:t_85:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It feels like my daughter just refused to take a bath with me...」

853:t_86:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Mr. $$シンジ$$ has been in top form lately, hasn't he? Isn't the title of ace of $c coming into view now?」

853:t_86:6.en:
$$シンジ$$
「That's not true. I'm nobody special.」

853:t_86:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My, how modest. Even so, I, AG, will go on looking forward to Mr. $$シンジ$$'s growth.」

853:t_86:8.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Thanks. I'll... do everything I can, too.」

853:t_86:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(If he keeps growing up honest and upright like this, what kind of adult will Mr. $$シンジ$$ become...)

853:t_87:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Mr. $$シンジ$$ has been in top form lately, hasn't he? Isn't the title of ace of $c coming into view now?」

853:t_87:6.en:
$$シンジ$$
「That's not true. I'm nobody special...」

853:t_87:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My, how modest. Even so, I, AG, will go on looking forward to Mr. $$シンジ$$'s growth.」

853:t_87:8.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Thanks. I'll... do everything I can, too.」

853:t_87:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(If $$サードインパクト$$ hadn't happened back then, how would Mr. $$シンジ$$ have grown up...)

853:t_87:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(What kind of fate awaits you from here, even I have no way of knowing. But as for where it leads... I'll be looking forward to it.)

853:t_88:4.en:
$$アスカ$$
「Ah... so my kill count passed 80...」

853:t_88:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How blase... Truly the mark of an adult.」

853:t_88:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Please don't underestimate a dimensional merchant's information network.」

853:t_88:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Not that I have any intention of telling anyone, mind you.」

853:t_88:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I can't very well make light of the weight of Miss $$アスカ$$'s long days of battle.」
